name: dotatraker
releaseNotes: Chat & moments for each match: full in-game chat (toxic lines flagged), plus glyph, pauses, first blood and disconnects. Needs the updated engine (downloads on start).

description: DotaTraker: who reported whom in Dota 2 matches, behind an access key.
